post_process_generation: postprocess a list of Nougat-generated text strings with markdown fixes and multiprocessing workers
post_process_single: postprocess a single Nougat-generated text string fixing markdown, tables, and hallucinated references
markdown_compatible: convert raw text to markdown-compatible formatting with equation tags and clickable URLs
correct_tables: fix LaTeX tabular blocks and table formatting in generated text to proper markdown structure
remove_hallucinated_references: detect and remove hallucinated or missing references from Nougat-generated text
